notes: _exist is documented shorthand for %sysfunc(fileexist()). Macro definition copied verbatim from upstream. Caller writes a small file with a plain DATA _null_ step (mirroring the macro's own VALIDATION TEST STREAM pattern of checking a file expected to exist), then uses _exist to confirm it now exists (RC=1) alongside a name that does not exist (RC=0), landed into a dataset and printed.
